questions.stem: — The boy's ______ surprised everyone when he solved the difficult math problem in just two minutes.
questions.expl: 考查名词词义辨析。句意：当这个男孩在两分钟内解出这道难的数学题时，他的_______ 让所有人都感到惊讶。A. talent 天赋(侧重某方面的特殊才能)；B. intelligence 智力(指理解、 学习和解决问题的能力)；C. courage 勇气；D. patience 耐心。根据“solved the difficult math problem” 可知，快速解出难题体现的是智力，而非单一领域的天赋。故选B。

questions.stem: _______ she will join the school art club, but she hasn't decided yet.
questions.expl: 考查副词词义辨析。句意：_______她会加入学校艺术俱乐部，但她还没决定。A. Certainly 当然；B. Finally 最终；C. Luckily 幸运地；D. Perhaps 也许。根据“hasn't decided yet” 可知，加 入俱乐部的可能性并不确定，只有“perhaps” 符合语境。故选D。

questions.stem: The city plans to reduce traffic jams by encouraging people to use public _____ like buses and subways.
questions.expl: 考查名词词义辨析。句意：城市计划通过鼓励人们使用公交_______(如公交车和地铁) 来减少交通拥堵。A. roads 道路；B. signals 信号；C. rules 规则；D. vehicles 交通工具。根据“buses and subways” 可知，此处指公共交通工具。故选D。

questions.stem: The new movie _______ changed her idea about science fiction—she used to think it was boring.
questions.expl: 考查副词词义辨析。句意：这部新电影_______改变了她对科幻片的看法—— 她过去觉 得它很无聊。A. completely 完全地；B. gradually 逐渐地；C. suddenly 突然地；D. hardly 几乎不。 根据“used to think it was boring” 可知，现在看法与过去完全相反，强调改变的彻底性。故选A。

questions.stem: The science project should _______ three parts: research, experiments, and a conclusion.
questions.expl: 考查动词词义辨析。句意：这个科学项目应该_______三个部分：研究、实验和结论。A. collect 收集；B. separate 分离；C. include 包括；D. repeat 重复。根据“three parts” 可知，此处指项目包 含的组成部分。故选C。

questions.stem: You can _______ take the bus _______ ride a bike to the park. Both ways are convenient.
questions.expl: 考查连词短语辨析。句意：你可以_______坐公交_______骑自行车去公园，两种方式都很 方便。A. either...or... 要么…… 要么……(二选一)；B. neither...nor... 既不…… 也不……；C. both...and... 两者都；D. not only...but (also)... 不仅…… 而且……。根据“Both ways are convenient” 可知，此处指两种方式选其一。故选A。

questions.stem: Dogs and wolves _______ each other because they come from the same family of animals.
questions.expl: 考查短语辨析。句意：狗和狼_______彼此，因为它们来自同一动物家族。A. are related to 与…… 有关联；B. are angry with 对…… 生气；C. are famous for 因…… 闻名；D. are interested in 对…… 感兴趣。根据“come from the same family” 可知，两者在血缘上有关联。故选A。

questions.stem: If you don’t know the meaning of this word, you can______ in the dictionary.
questions.expl: look for 寻找。look up 查阅。代词只能放在中间。句意：如果你不知道这个单词的意思， 你可以在字典查阅。故答案选D

questions.stem: He doesn’t have ________ I do.
questions.expl: 句意：他没有我那么多朋友。 考查原级比较。不如……多：not as/so many+名词复数+as，结合选项可知，选项C 符合。故选C。

questions.stem: —Would you like to tell me ________ important news?—Sorry, I don’t want to tell you ________ news today.
questions.expl: 句意：——你能告诉我一些重要消息吗？——对不起，今天我不想告诉你任何消息。 考查some 和any 的用法。第一个句子是一般疑问句，希望得到肯定回答，用some；第二个句子是 否定句，用any。故选B。

questions.stem: In the old society(社会), many old people ______ cold in the countryside in winter.A died of
questions.expl: die of 制die from 的区别：若死因存在于人体之上或之内(主要指疾病、衰老等自身的原 因), 一般用介词of,若死因不是存在人体之内或之上而是由坏境造成的(主要指事故等方面的外 部原因),一般用介词from。die out 灭绝，死光。Cold 寒冷，感冒，疾病。用A

questions.stem: Although she spends most of her time on science, she _______ painting and has won several awards.
questions.expl: 本文介绍了如何有效地使用词典来学习英语。

questions.stem: amazingA dictionary is very useful for the people who are learning English. People will use a dictionary forhelp when they have difficulty in reading a passage or doing English exercises. You will make moreprogress if you know how to use a dictionary efficiently (有效地).1Choose a suitable (合适的) dictionary.2You can choose a dictionary which is suitablefor your English level, needs and interests. For a middle school student in Grade 9, you can chooseOXFORD INTERMEDIATE LEARNER’S ENGLISH--CHINESE DICTIONARY.Try to guess the meaning of a new word before you use a dictionary. You may have had such anexperience when you are reading a passage. There’re some new words in it and you have difficulty inunderstanding the full passage. What will you do in this situation?3Learn culture from a dictionary. You don’t just learn a new word’s pronunciation, meaning, part ofspeech and other usages.4A dictionary is a good friend for learning English. It’s a waste for you not to use a dictionary in yourstudy. But don’t think the more you use a dictionary, the better result you can get.5If you can do as I have told you, I think you will improve your English soon.
opts: You can learn some cultural knowledge from a dictionary as well.
You should use your dictionary in the right way.
Here are some ideas on how to use a dictionary efficiently.
Choosing a good dictionary is very important for an English learner.
I think you should guess the meaning before you use your dictionary.
questions.expl: 本文作者通过自己和Detmar 的故事，告诉我们，要多帮助别人，并把这种善行传递。

questions.stem: A. he
questions.expl: 下文“Choose a suitable (合适的) dictionary...Try to guess the meaning of a new word before you use a dictionary...”可知，下文是具体建议，此处应是引出如何有效地使用字典的建议，选项C“这里 有一些关于如何有效使用词典的建议”符合语境。故选C。

questions.stem: A. bear
questions.expl: 上文“Choose a suitable (合适的) dictionary.”和下文“You can choose a dictionary...”可知，此处 应与“选择词典”有关，选项D“选择一本好词典对英语学习者来说是非常重要的”符合语境。故选D。

questions.stem: A. at
questions.expl: 前文“Try to guess the meaning of a new word before you use a dictionary.”可知，此处应是建议 在使用词典前先猜测单词的意思，选项E“我认为你在使用词典之前应该先猜一下意思”符合语境。 故选E。

questions.stem: A. one
questions.expl: 上文“Learn culture from a dictionary. You don’t just learn a new word’s pronunciation, meaning, part of speech and other usages.”可知，此处应是指从词典中学习文化知识，选项A“你也可以从词典 中学到一些文化知识”符合语境。故选A。

questions.stem: A. big
questions.expl: 上文“But don’t think the more you use a dictionary, the better result you can get.”可知，不要认 为使用词典越多，就能取得越好的效果，所以此处应是强调要以正确的方式使用词典，选项B“你 应该正确地使用词典”符合语境。故选B。

questions.stem: A. interest
questions.expl: ：Tim 对两件事很感兴趣，计算机和大脑是如何工作的。 interest 兴趣；interests 复数；interested 感兴趣；interesting 有趣的。be interested in“对……感兴趣”。 故选C。

questions.stem: A. connect
questions.expl: ：大脑怎么能这么快地连接这么多事实？ connect 连接，原形；connects 三单形式；connected 过去式；connecting 动名词。情态动词could 后 接动词原形，故选A。

questions.stem: A. no
questions.expl: ：他们分享了一些关于计算机的信息。 no 不；some 一些，既可修饰不可数名词也可修饰可数名词；little 少(几乎没有)；many 许多， 修饰可数名词。根据“He had to work with people all over the world. And they shared…information about computers.”可知是指他们分享了一些关于计算机的信息。此处需要some 修饰不可数名词 information。故选B。
：他一次又一次地回答同样的问题。 a 一个，用以辅音音素开头的单词；an 一个，用以元音音素开头的单词；the 表特指。根据“same questions”可知，此处需要用定冠词the 表示特指。故选D。

questions.stem: A. share
questions.expl: ：同一办公室的计算机甚至很难共享信息。 share 分享，原形；shared 过去式；sharing 动名词；to share 不定式。固定结构：it is+形容词+for sb to do sth.，故选D。

questions.stem: A. invents
questions.expl: ：1989 年，Tim 独自发明了万维网(WWW)。 invents 发明，三单形式；invented 过去式；inventor 发明家；invention 发明，名词。根据时间状语“in 1989”可知，此处需要用一般过去时的动词invented。故选B。

questions.stem: A. something
questions.expl: ：Tim 不认为他做了什么特别的事。 something 某事；anything 任何事；nothing 没什么；everything 每件事。此处是否定句，需要用不定 代词anything 表示Tim 不认为他做了什么特别的事。故选B。

questions.stem: A. other
questions.expl: ：他说，许多其他人共同努力使互联网成为今天的样子。 other 其他的；the other 其他的(两者之间)；others 其他的人/物；another 另一个。此处表示“其他

questions.stem: A. But
questions.expl: ：然而，Tim 免费赠送了万维网。 But 但是；However 然而；And 和；Though 尽管。根据“Most inventors want to become rich…Tim gave away the World Wide Web for nothing.”可知是转折关系，且用逗号隔开。此处需要用副词However 表示“然而”。故选B。

questions.stem: A. important
questions.expl: 本文讲述了Tim Berners Lee 发明了电脑。

questions.stem: Why did the writer talk about the strange animals in Paragraph 1?
questions.expl: ：不论何时你被帮助了，试着将它传递下去。 troubled 苦恼；helped 帮助；heard 听说；ordered 命令。根据“...it is important to remember helping others can make the world better.”可知帮助别人会让世界变好，如果你被帮助了，记得传递下去。故选B。

questions.stem: The underlined word “inspired” in Paragraph 1 has similar meaning to the underlined word in _______.
opts: We need someone to inspire the team.
He inspired many young people to take up basketball.
His driving hardly inspires confidence (信心).
His book was inspired by the story of a little girl.
questions.expl: ：1999 年，我第一次独自前往欧洲，乘坐巴士途经慕尼黑，当时我病得很重，不得不被送往 医院。 trip 旅行；flight 航班；business 商业；experience 经验；经历。根据“to Europe alone on a bus tour through Munich”可知此处指去欧洲的旅行。故选A。

questions.stem: Which of the following can you find in Shan Hai Jing?①states②mountains③rivers④plants⑤monsters
questions.expl: ：当我坐在候诊室时，我感觉很无助和疼痛，一个男护士向我走来。 angry 生气的；surprised 惊讶的；helpless 无助的；excited 兴奋的。根据“...to Europe alone on a bus tour through Munich when I became very ill and had to be taken to a hospital.”可知独自一人在欧洲时，生病 会感觉无助。故选C。

questions.stem: What is the main idea of the last paragraph?
opts: Many works borrow ideas from Shan Hai Jing.
Shan Hai Jing includes many special monsters.
Some monsters in the book go into movies.
Shan Hai Jing inspires Pop culture works.
questions.expl: 本文主要是讲述了中国的《山海经》启发了世界的许多作品。

questions.stem: What does the web-based EOL aim to do?
opts: To work out the number of birds.
To find out what covers the Earth.
To name all the living things on Earth.
questions.expl: 判断题。由第一段句子“Foxes with nine tails, animals with human faces and fish bodies, turtles with bird heads and snake tails...these magical animals are from Shan Hai Jing (The Classic of Mountains and Seas)”可知，作者提到这些奇怪的动物是为了吸引读者，故选C。

questions.stem: What is one of the characteristics(特点)of the EOL?
opts: It is set up by school students.
It has been open to the public.
It is about different types of grass and birds.
It produces different kinds of information about species.
questions.expl: 判断题。根据“So far, scientists have named about 1.8 million living species, but that is just a small number of what probably lives on Earth. With so many plants, animals, and other living things on the planet, it can be difficult to find out what kind of grass is growing by the roadside or what kind of birds just flew by.”可知地球上有如此多的植物、动物和其他生物，很难知道路边长着什么样的草，

questions.stem: What does the underlined part “that process” refer to?
questions.expl: 猜测题。根据“It takes years for scientists to collect all the data they need to analyze species now. The scientists of the Encyclopaedia of Life hope that EOL will speed up that process.”可知现在，科学家 需要数年时间来收集分析物种所需的所有数据。生命百科全书的科学家们希望EOL 能加快收集数 据这一进程。可推出that process 指代“收集数据”。故选A。

questions.stem: Which of the following is TRUE according to the passage?
opts: There are 1.8 million living species on earth.
There are no non-scientists helping in the site.
EOL is not useful for you to choose information.
As the EOL develops, students might find it’s useful for them.
questions.expl: 本文讲了一些科学家建立了基于网络的生命百科全书，详细地介绍了它的目的和一些信息。
